moneyRefunds.title: Refunds & wallet
moneyRefunds.sub: Every refund the shop owes, from asking to paid out, and the late-delivery apology credit. Nothing is paid by itself: you approve, a person sends the money, then records it here.

none.approve: No refund is waiting for approval.
none.payout: No approved refund is waiting to be paid out.
none.done: No refund has been paid out yet.
none.all: No refund yet. A paid order that is cancelled or comes back asks for one by itself.

list.title: Refunds
list.more: Showing the newest {n}. Older ones are on their orders.

method.original: Back the way it was paid

apology.title: Late orders: apology credit
apology.sub: Delivered later than promised, no apology credit yet. The credit goes to the customer's wallet, once per order.
apology.off: The apology credit is off. Switch it on under More options below.
apology.none: No late order is waiting for an apology credit.
apology.ruleUnset: The rule has no amount yet

what.approve: Approving says {amount} may go back to the customer. It sends no money.
what.reject: The refund is closed and not paid. The customer sees it was not approved.
what.complete: Send {amount} to the customer first (bKash send-money or the bank), then write its reference here.
what.completeWallet: {amount} is added to the customer's wallet now, as store credit.
what.fail: The money did not reach the customer (a wrong number, a bounced transfer). It stays owed; mark it paid when it goes through.
what.apology: Type the credit for this order. It goes to the customer's wallet, once.
what.apologyRule: The owner's rule gives {amount}. It goes to the customer's wallet, once.

f.toWallet: Give it as store credit to the wallet instead
f.reference: Reference of the money sent (TrxID or bank reference)

err.CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Tick the box to confirm first.
err.SAME_PERSON: Four eyes is on: the person who asked for this refund may not approve it.
err.NOT_PENDING: This refund has moved on already. The page is read again.
err.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: That way is not allowed by the refund rules.
err.NO_CUSTOMER: The order has no customer, so there is no wallet.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is missing or wrong in the form.
err.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This was already recorded differently. Read the page again.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found. It may have been removed from view.
err.NOT_LATE: The order did not come late enough for the rule.
err.NOT_CONFIGURED: The rule has no amount yet.
err.ALREADY_RECORDED: This order has its apology credit already.
err.ORDER_CLOSED: This order is not one to apologise for.
err.WALLET_OFF: Changing a wallet by hand is off.
err.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The wallet does not hold that much.
err.NOT_REVERSIBLE: This line is put right through a refund, not a reversal.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.other: That did not work. Try again.

card.readOnly: Only someone who may change settings can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card. It is read again; check and save once more.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.other: That did not work. Try again.

refunds.d: When a refund may be asked and how it goes back. Every refund still needs approval.
refunds.toWalletHelp: Off: money goes back the way it was paid.
refunds.afterDeliveryHelp: Off: after delivery the route is an exchange, except the reasons ticked below.
refunds.sources: Refund after delivery still allowed for
refunds.rto: A prepaid parcel that comes back
refunds.rtoAdvance: A delivery-charge advance on a refused parcel
refunds.rtoAdvanceASK: Ask it back with the rest
refunds.fourEyesHelp: The person who asked for a refund may not approve it.

walletManual.h: Wallet credit or debit by hand
walletManual.d: Lets a team member with the wallet permission add or take store credit on a customer's page, with a reason.

apology.d: Store credit for an order that arrived later than promised, once per order.
apology.modePER_ORDER: A person types it for each order
apology.lateHelp: Rule only. 0: any time after the promise.

wallet.title: Wallet · {name}
wallet.drift: The balance and the ledger differ: the ledger adds up to {ledger}. Tell the owner; nothing is hidden.
wallet.closed: This wallet is not active. Nothing can be added or taken.
wallet.none: No wallet yet. It opens with the first credit.
wallet.more: The newest {n} lines are shown. The older ones stay in the ledger.

adjust.title: Add or take money by hand
adjust.sub: For a promise made on the phone, or to fix a mistake. Every line keeps its reason and your name, and can be put right later.
adjust.off: Changing a wallet by hand is off. The owner can switch it on under Money › Refunds & wallet › More options.
adjust.noPerm: Changing a wallet needs the wallet permission. Ask the owner.
adjust.noMax: No limit on a single line.

reverse.what: A new line the other way, {amount}, cancels this one. The first line stays in the ledger.
reverse.done: Put right with a new line.

apology.title: His late orders: apology credit
apology.off: The apology credit is off. The owner can switch it on under Money › Refunds & wallet › More options.
